// divguard:path internal/codingagent/interactive_turn.go

package codingagent

import "context"

type Session struct{}

func (*Session) SendContent(context.Context, string) error { return nil }

type Tx struct{}

func (*Tx) Send(id, input string) error { return nil }

type InteractiveMode struct {
	session  *Session
	abortCtx context.Context
}

// runTurn goes through the session layer, which owns the post-run loop.
func (m *InteractiveMode) runTurn(text string, tx *Tx) error {
	if err := m.session.SendContent(m.abortCtx, text); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Send("conversation", text)
}
